questions.question: What was the average temperature for the Seattle device in August 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM sensor_readings WHERE device_id = 1;

questions.question: What was the maximum temperature recorded by the Sydney device?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(MAX(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM sensor_readings WHERE device_id = 3;

questions.question: What was the minimum temperature recorded across all devices?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(MIN(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM sensor_readings;

questions.question: What was the average temperature for the Paris device during the first week of August 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM sensor_readings WHERE device_id = 5 AND time >= '2026-08-01' AND time < '2026-08-08';

questions.question: What was the highest temperature recorded by the Victoria device on August 15, 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(MAX(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM sensor_readings WHERE device_id = 6 AND time >= '2026-08-15' AND time < '2026-08-16';

questions.question: Which device had the highest average temperature in August 2026 and what was the temperature?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT device_id, ROUND(CAST(AVG(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY device_id ORDER BY ROUND(CAST(AVG(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Which device had the lowest average temperature and what was the temperature?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT device_id, ROUND(CAST(AVG(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY device_id ORDER BY ROUND(CAST(AVG(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) ASC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Which device was warmer, London or Paris, and what was their temperature?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT device_id, ROUND(CAST(AVG(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM sensor_readings WHERE device_id IN (4, 5) GROUP BY device_id ORDER BY ROUND(CAST(AVG(temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: How many times did the Sydney device go offline in August 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_status WHERE device_id = 3 AND online = false;

questions.question: What was the total downtime for the London device in hours?
questions.reference_sql: WITH time_pairs AS (SELECT time, online, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time, LEAD(online) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_online FROM device_status WHERE device_id = 4) SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_time - time)) / 3600) AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM time_pairs WHERE next_online IS TRUE AND online IS FALSE;

questions.question: Which device had the most total downtime (in hours) in August 2026?
questions.reference_sql: WITH time_pairs AS (SELECT device_id, time, online, LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY time) AS next_time, LEAD(online) OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY time) AS next_online FROM device_status), results AS (SELECT device_id, ROUND(CAST(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_time - time)) / 3600) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_downtime FROM time_pairs WHERE next_online IS TRUE AND online IS FALSE GROUP BY device_id) SELECT device_id, total_downtime FROM results ORDER BY total_downtime DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Was the Seattle device online or offline at 3:00 PM UTC on August 20, 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT online FROM device_status WHERE device_id = 1 AND time <= '2026-08-20 15:00:00' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What is the average temperature of devices located in the Northern Hemisphere?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.temperature) AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM sensor_readings r JOIN devices d ON r.device_id = d.id WHERE d.latitude > 0;

questions.question: Which device is geographically closest to Seattle other than Seattle?
questions.reference_sql: WITH results AS (SELECT d2.id AS device_id, SQRT((d2.latitude - d1.latitude)^2 + (d2.longitude - d1.longitude)^2) AS distance FROM devices d1 CROSS JOIN devices d2 WHERE d1.name = 'd_seattle' AND d2.name != 'd_seattle') SELECT device_id FROM results ORDER BY distance LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What was the temperature reading for the Victoria device at exactly midnight UTC on August 1, 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(temperature AS NUMERIC), 2) FROM sensor_readings WHERE device_id = 6 AND time = '2026-08-01 00:00:00';

questions.question: Did the Sao Paulo device have any readings during a period when it should have been offline?
questions.reference_sql: WITH time_pairs AS (SELECT time, online, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time, LEAD(online) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_online FROM device_status WHERE device_id = 2), outage_events AS (SELECT time, next_time FROM time_pairs WHERE next_online IS TRUE AND online IS FALSE) SELECT r.* FROM sensor_readings r JOIN outage_events o ON r.time >= o.time AND r.time < o.next_time WHERE r.device_id = 2;
